title: Basic-open sections compare a quasi-coherent complex with its K-injective resolution
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $g\in A$, and $F,J$ integer-indexed complexes of module sheaves on $\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Assume every $F^n$ is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent], $J$ is K-injective, and $i:F\to J$ is a quasi-isomorphism. Then the map of $A$-module complexes $\Gamma(D(g),i)$, with sections and the $A$-action as in [def-sc-principal-open-alternating-total], is a quasi-isomorphism. No boundedness or quasi-coherence of the terms of $J$ is required.

source.place: Tag 08C2, one-element affine cover; Tags 08BS and 08D2. Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08C2 and /08D2; local TeX absent.

proof.text: Restrict i to the affine basic open D(g). Restriction is exact and preserves K-injective complexes, so it is still a quasi-isomorphism into a K-injective complex.

Use the basis of all affine opens of D(g). Restriction preserves quasi-coherence. Kernels, images and cokernels of differentials of F are quasi-coherent, so the terms, differential cokernels and cohomology sheaves have vanishing positive cohomology on every member of this basis. All three acyclicity conditions and the basis-covering condition of Tag 08C2 hold.

Apply the unbounded alternating Cech derived-section comparison on the restricted affine scheme with its one-element cover by itself. The total on this cover is the ordinary section complex. Its invertible comparison to derived sections is the map obtained by applying sections to a K-injective resolution. Initially compute with an injective-term K-injective resolution, then compare it with the given one by a homotopy equivalence. Additive sections preserve this homotopy equivalence, so the displayed map is a quasi-isomorphism for the given i.

Restriction of scalars from O(D(g)) to A leaves the underlying cohomology groups and their maps unchanged. Therefore this is exactly the quasi-isomorphism of A-module complexes given by affineOpenSections. If D(g) is empty both complexes are zero.

theorem principalOpenSections_resolution_quasiIso
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (g : A)
    (F J : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hF : ∀ n : ℤ, (F.X n).IsQuasicoherent)
    [J.IsKInjective] (i : F ⟶ J) [QuasiIso i] :
    QuasiIso (((affineOpenSections A (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map i)
